intro: Playa Vista is a newer, walkable planned neighborhood built around the Runway shopping district, parks and tech offices, right next to the Ballona Wetlands. Everyday errands, dinner and a movie are all a short walk apart.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites Nathaniel checked)

A fast, fresh counter-service spot with plates, salads and a wine list.

places.w: The neighborhood's walkable center, with restaurants, a Whole Foods, a movie theater, fire pits and play areas.
places.o: Dinner and a movie; the theater validates parking.

places.w: A protected coastal wetland with birding and a walking and bike path that links Marina del Rey and Playa del Rey.
